title: 健康・体力づくり
subtitle: Introduction to Fitness and Health Promotion

keywords: Warm-up 2.Measurement and diagnosis in physical 3.Exercise prescription 4.Lifestyle-related diseases 5.Self-management
educationalGoal: To lead a healthy and fulfilling life throughout their own lifetime, students will learn the following: (1) Knowledge about fitness and health promotion and lifestyle-related diseases, (2) Procedures for measuring and analyzing personal health and physical fitness characteristics, (3) How to develop a personal exercise prescription (training program), (4) How to understand and practice health and fitness self-care, (5) Various risks in student/social life, and (6) How to cooperate, lead, and observe rules
advice: Students will learn knowledge and procedures for health promotion through measurement and diagnosis in health and physical fitness, the development of safe and effective individual exercise prescription/training programs, lifestyle-related diseases, and health care procedures. Specifically, students will learn the following: 1.Methods for warm-up exercises, 2.Measurement and diagnosis procedures in physical fitness, 3.Methods for strength, endurance, and shape-up training, 4.Exercise prescription procedures, 5.Knowledge about lifestyle-related diseases and health care procedures, 6.Self-management of diet, sleeping, and exercise habits for health promotion, and 7.Risks in student/social life. Classes will be held once per week (100 minutes). In practical classes, students should wear appropriate clothing such as sportswear, T-shirts, shorts, and indoor shoes. Students should aim to attend all classes highly motivated to learn. Students should pay attention to their own health condition. Students should understand the knowledge and procedures necessary for health promotion, and practice them in student life and throughout their lifetime. Practice classes will take place in the gymnasium (Building 20), and lectures will take place in the lecture hall shown on the class schedule.
requiredKnowledge: Taking an interest in various types of news and information about health and physical fitness. Preparing for physical activities and understanding safety management in sports activities.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand the procedures of exercise prescription and design effective training programs.
Be able to understand express the importance of health promotion throughout their lifetime.
Be able to understand and practice fundamental social skills such as cooperation and leadership.
Be able to understand the importance of self-management of lifestyle habits and to lead a healthy life.
Be able to study actively while paying careful attention to one's own health and fitness characteristics.
Be able to understand various health-related problems and explain these coping behaviors.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Fully understand the concepts and protocols of exercise prescription and assessment in physical fitness.(2) Fully understand various training methods, and design a safe and effective personal exercise prescription based on one's own goals and physical condition.(3) Fully understand the importance of managing one's own health and fitness condition throughout their lifetime, and explain their own views of it.(4) Understand effective warm-up protocols and carry them out with tremendous leadership or cooperation.(5) Understand the importance of the continuous health promotion throughout one's life, and apply it to daily life.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Understand the concepts and protocols of exercise prescription and assessment in physical fitness.(2) Understand the points of various training methods, and roughly design a safe and effective personal exercise prescription based on one's own goals and physical condition.(3) Understand the importance of managing one's own health and fitness condition throughout their lifetime, and explain their own views of it.(4) Understand effective warm-up protocols and carry them out with leadership and cooperation.(5) Understand the importance of continuous health promotion throughout one's life, and roughly apply it to daily life.

lessons.content: 1. Guidance about annual courses of life-long sports classes 2. Guidance about this class 3. Explanation about the importance of health promotion throughout one's own life and the relationships with the contents of this class.
lessons.operation: This class will be conducted in the lecture hall. Explain the annual courses of life-long sports classes, the contents of this class, and the importance of health promotion throughout one’s own life time.
lessons.assignments: Review: Students should read handouts carefully. Assignment: Fill out a health assessment sheet on daily life habits.

lessons.content: 1. Instructions about how to use the gymnasium and locker room. 2. Instructions about safety precautions during exercise. 3. Physical fitness tests (sit-up and side step tests)
lessons.operation: Explain how to use the gymnasium and locker room, and safety precautions during exercise. Physical fitness tests (sit-up and side step tests) will be conducted.
lessons.assignments: Assignment: Fill out a health assessment sheet on daily life habits.

lessons.content: 1. Physical fitness tests (physique, body composition, blood pressure, muscular strength, power, flexibility, etc.)
lessons.operation: Warm-up exercises will be done under a leader. Physical fitness tests will be conducted in cooperation with a few group members.
lessons.assignments: Assignment: Fill out the results of the physical fitness test and a health assessment sheet on daily life habits.

lessons.operation: Warm-up exercises will be done under a leader. Students will understand how to use the training room and various training machines. Muscular strength tests will be conducted in cooperation with a few group members.
lessons.assignments: Assignment: Fill out the results of the muscular strength test and a health assessment sheet on daily life habits.

lessons.operation: Warm-up exercises will be done under a leader. A 20-m shuttle run test will be done in cooperation with paired members.
lessons.assignments: Assignment: Fill out the results of the endurance test and a health assessment sheet on daily life habits.

lessons.content: 1. Assessment and analysis of one's own physical fitness characteristics
lessons.operation: This class will be conducted in the lecture hall. Students will summarize their own physical fitness test results, develop a profile of their own physical fitness characteristics, explain how to use the “health and fitness carte” system, and conduct a self-assessment test for mental health.
lessons.assignments: Assignment: Enter your own measurements data into the “health and fitness care” system, and develop a profile of your own physical fitness ( the date of submission follows the teacher's instruction). Fill out a health assessment sheet on daily life habits.

lessons.content: 1. Concepts and protocols of exercise prescription (development of training programs) 2. Review of attendance and learning approach in the previous classes.
lessons.operation: This class will be conducted in the lecture hall. Students will explain the concepts and procedures of exercise prescription ( training programs). Students will develop a personal training program based on the results of a physical fitness test. Attendance and learning approach in the previous classes will be reviewed.
lessons.assignments: Assignment: Develop “Report 2 ” related to exercise prescription (the date of submission follows the teacher's instruction). Fill out a health assessment sheet on daily life habits.

lessons.content: 1. Muscular strength training using strength-training machines; practice personal muscular strength training under an appropriate load for individuals.
lessons.operation: Warm-up exercises will be done under a leader. Students will learn muscular strength training methods with machines. Students will implement muscular strength training based on their own exercise prescription developed in the previous classes.
lessons.assignments: Assignment: Develop “Report 2 ” related to exercise prescription (the date of submission follows the teacher's instruction). Fill out a health assessment sheet on daily life habits.

lessons.content: 1. Endurance training 2. Maximal and target heart rate 3. Rating of perceived exertion (RPE) scale Understand the appropriate exercise intensity based on heart rate, and the interrelationship between running pace, heart rate, and RPE score.
lessons.operation: Warm-up exercises will be done under a leader. Students will understand the relationship between running pace, heart rate, and RPE through monitoring heart rate during a 20-min paced run.
lessons.assignments: Assignment: Develop “Report 3 ” related to endurance raining (the date of submission follows the teacher's instruction). Fill out a health assessment sheet on daily life habits.

lessons.content: 1. Shape-up training 2. Measurement of calorie consumption during various exercises Learn the various shape-up training methods. Understand the relationship between physical activities and calorie consumption.
lessons.operation: Warm-up exercises will be done under a leader. Students will understand the relationship between exercise volume and calorie consumption through various shape-up exercises.
lessons.assignments: Assignment: Develop “Report 3 ” related to shape-up training and calorie consumption (the date of submission follows the teacher's instruction). Fill out a health assessment sheet on daily life habits.

lessons.content: 1. Core (trunk of the body) training Experience ball exercises and core training, and learn various training techniques that can be done at home.
lessons.operation: Warm-up exercises will be done under a leader. Students will engage in calisthenics or balance ball exercises.
lessons.assignments: Assignment: Fill out a health assessment sheet on daily life habits.

lessons.content: 1. Selection of one's own course in the “Academic Exercise in Lifelong Sports”. 2. Review of attendance and learning approach in the previous classes.
lessons.operation: Students will choose their own “Academic Exercise in Lifelong Sports” course. Students will complete various measurements required for developing reports (for absent students).
lessons.assignments: Assignment: Fill out a health assessment sheet on daily life habits.

lessons.content: 1. Health promotion in daily life based on health, obesity, and lifestyle-related diseases.
lessons.operation: This class will be conducted in the lecture hall. Students will explain the concept of lifestyle-related disease. Students will learn the necessity and importance of health promotion and its procedures.
lessons.assignments: Review: Important information about lifestyle-related diseases based on handouts. Assignments: Fill out a health assessment sheet on daily life habits.

lessons.content: 1. Risk of drug dependence 2. A written test will be conducted.
lessons.operation: This class will be conducted in the lecture hall. Students will consider various health-related problems including drug dependence and their coping behavior throughout group discussion. A written test will be conducted.
lessons.assignments: Assignment: Fill out a health assessment sheet on daily life habits.

lessons.content: 1. Summarize the class contents. 2. Review of attendance, submission of reports, and grades. 3. Guidance about the “Academic Exercise in Lifelong Sports” course in the next term.
lessons.operation: This class will be conducted in the lecture hall. Attendance, submission of reports, and grades will be reviewed. The concept of the “Academic Exercise in Lifelong Sports” course in the next term will be explained.
lessons.assignments: Review: What was learned in class. Read the instructions for the “Academic Exercise in Lifelong Sports” course thoroughly, and keep until the beginning of the next term.
